hero.headline: I cross the BC–WA border weekly. Let me bring things for you.
hero.subtext: I commute between British Columbia and Washington State. I can buy or carry items across the border at a reasonable fee.

services.title: Services
services.buy_desc: I purchase on my credit card in the US — minimal fee (I earn points)
services.carry_desc: You buy it and ship to my WA address — I carry it across for a reasonable fee

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.rule1: ~20% of the US/CA price difference as a reference rate — not fixed
pricing.rule2: Larger packages cost more; oversized items (> car trunk) not accepted
pricing.rule3: Buy for Me: minimal or no fee — I earn credit card points
pricing.rule4: Carry for Me: standard carrying fee applies
pricing.rule5: Final price confirmed after reviewing your request via your contact

how.title: How It Works
how.step1_desc: Fill out the form below with what you need
how.step2_desc: I'll review and reply via your contact with a quote
how.step3_desc: Your item arrives on my next border crossing

form.title: Submit a Request
form.service_carry: Carry for Me (I already purchased it)
form.item_link_placeholder: Amazon or other shopping site URL
form.size_large_error: Sorry, we don't accept oversized items.
form.success: Your request has been received. I'll follow up via your provided contact.

footer.text: PassBy · 顺路带 — Personal service, informal operation, legal items only
